bibl.title: Using Raman spectroscopy to estimate the dates of carbon-based inks from Ancient Egypt.
bibl.seg: Sarah Goler, Alexis Hagadorn, David M. Ratzan, Roger Bagnall, Angela Cacciola, James McInerney & James T. Yardley, Using Raman spectroscopy to estimate the dates of carbon-based inks from Ancient Egypt.
bibl.note: 1. Introduction. - 2. Experimental. - 3. The17-manuscript study: results and correlation analysis. - 4. Correlation verification through a blind study. - 5. Additional manuscripts outside date range of 17-manuscript study. - 6. Gaussian mixture modeling (GMM) for classification of carbon-based pigments. - 7. Example of two inks on a single manuscript fragment. - 8. Discussion. - 9. Conclusions. - "This methodology can constitute a strong indication of the antiquity and rough period for ancient inks. Statistical analysis can provide date estimates for papyri to ± 120 years with 68% confidence."
